entry_points.text: Nested exit entry reports zero length for failure, invalid and failed-entry cases, otherwise hardware length, then transfers to full exit handling.

Structure load resolves address then branches on enlightenment; enlightened path needs assist page or aborts and propagates flush rights; hardware faults are spurious, errors go to instrumented handler.
Nested exit syncs regs and controls to nested area; CR views merge three sources; timer scales remaining flooring at zero; rare state defers unless enlightened valid; CET gated by features.
Exit recording stores reason and qualification with enclave merge; failed entry stops early, else marks launched, transfers events and saves MSRs.

Mode helpers switch real, protected and v8086 and latch long on paging edges with descriptor updates, warning on nested real mode; segment fields cache per-field and invalidate on write; derives container.

exports.text: Validates guest enlightened controls against host masks across six categories, rejects upper-half functions; enables per vCPU with version, gates direct flush, requests synthetic exit.
Updates interrupt shadow preserving unrelated bits with move-SS preferred; records EFER when supported syncing entry mode and refreshing uret selection; looks up uret MSR slots.
Sets CR0/CR4 building hardware images with forced, mode and user-protection fixes, manages CR3 exiting from current paging and emulation; caches regs merging owned bits; saves four PDPTRs under PAE.
Writes and reads segments via cache with v8086 shadows, forced accessed and usability-derived present; builds exception bitmap from fixed faults plus debug, PF and nested state and programs filter.
Loads PDPTRs when dirty under PAE; drains current then guest TLB requests independently; maps field encodings to enlightened offsets with clean tags.

hazards.text: Access failures log once rate-limited with neutral return; spurious faults assert reboot underway; unexpected hardware codes warn.
Nested abort requests triple fault with rate-limited diagnostic and performs no guest recovery.

invariants.text: Field access dispatches on global enlightenment flag; misses yield zero or ignore; narrow hosts split wide ops; enlightened stores clear clean markers.
Guest enlightenment needs active Hyper-V plus userspace flag; pointer access returns stored value or absent depending on build.
Secondary features need primary activation plus queried bit; timer uses pin controls; guest TLB tag needs EPT or allocated second-level VPID.

Outer EFER follows entry, host, autoload, uret and host precedence; restore rebuilds MMU, CR3, PAT, EFER, debug, PDPTR and fixes dual-table MSRs via validated writes or aborts; DEBUGCTL keeps host bits or fixed bits with warning.
Guest and current flushes bump counters; guest path syncs roots without two-dimensional paging, calls vendor hook and drops Hyper-V state.
MSR store walks bounded list reading, validating and resolving each entry with TSC fast path and writing back values; rejects xAPIC, microcode, reserved and SMBASE entries.
Pending events clear vectoring for faults, else prioritize exception, NMI and interrupt with typed encodings; classification masks validity, type and vector; exit reason comes from VT area.

Exit returns to root MMU; CR3 validates with distinct codes, reloading PAE and rebuilding MMU; TLB honors Hyper-V then VPID and tag rules; CET gated; MSR load walks bounded list rejecting FS, GS, SMM entries and reporting failing index.
Uret selection gates syscall, TSC and perf by mode; transition EFER prefers atomic switch else masked uret; autoload lists append and compact with synced counts, recording load flags.
Rflags cache merges v8086 subset, writes direct for unrestricted else preserves mode bits reevaluating on mode change; unrestricted combines global, nesting and secondary toggle.

locks.text: Structure switch needs distinct target, pins CPU across load and host propagation, invalidates tracking; cross-CPU load clears remotely with ordered linkage, publishing current and refreshing host state.
Shadow image retrieval requires caller to hold the vCPU lock or the vCPU to be unreachable.

state_machines.text: Full exit discards traps, services flush, refreshes paging, leaves guest, restores time, syncs shadow, captures exit, switches structures, then loads host or unwinds on failure.
Nested failure reports invalid without descriptor or linkage, else valid with error code and shadow refresh; each path sets flags differently and skips past the instruction.

Enlightened lifecycle revalidates entitled pending pointers, maps and validates revisions or fails, zeroing on launch, clearing clean state and MSR maps; release drops identity; load reports disabled, ok, fail or error.

Host load orders EFER from control or size, regs, owned CRs, MMU and TLB, descriptors, flat segments, CET, PAT and perf, then debug and MSRs; aborts on failure with fixed flags, limits, debug and bound.

structs.text: Enlightened translation rotates encoding to slot, bounds-checks, rejects revision hole, and yields byte displacement plus cleanliness id.
Teardown releases mappings and cached refs; shadow refreshes stale link then writes back when valid; MSR limit derives from misc pair; host snapshot tracks selectors and bases on change.
Segments carry base, limit and selector plus packed rights and usability; real and protected conversions normalize attrs per emulation control with alignment warning.
Invalid is all-bits-set, pending next-lower, zero offset a hole; width classes live in low bits checked at build; enlightened version is one; debug and CR0 ownership fixed.
